offlineDraft.deviceDraftText:
Case Note

Maria Okonkwo-Reyes and Bea were present for this visit, which occurred on 12/11. Mould was observed in the back bedroom, exhibiting increased severity near the window. Attempts to contact the landlord regarding this issue have been unsuccessful, as she has not received a response to two emails. A benefits form, with a date of birth of 3/3/87, was noted, and (name not put back) missed the previous week’s deadline for submission. Discussions included the potential risk of rent arrears due to the late submission of the form.  A plan was agreed to contact the landlord on Monday and to have Maria Okonkwo-Reyes post the form by Friday, with assistance offered by a neighbor, Tomas Brandvold. A follow-up visit is scheduled for 26/11.

finishedText:
Case Note Date: 12/11

Maria Okonkwo-Reyes and Bea were present during the visit. Mould was observed in the back bedroom again and it is worse by the window. The landlord has not replied to two emails. Maria Okonkwo-Reyes missed the benefits form deadline last week and a letter regarding this is on the table. The date of birth on the form is 3/3/87. 

It was agreed that the worker will ring the landlord on Monday and Maria Okonkwo-Reyes will post the form on Friday. Tomas Brandvold, a neighbour who is also on the worker's list, offered to help her or her with the form. The identified risk is rent arrears if the form is late. The next steps are to revisit on 26/11.
